svg.text: Prefix cache arithmetic with the Anthropic multipliers, and a semantic cache on 48 questions with MiniLM
Prompt cache: units of one uncached prefix
write 1.25 (5 min) or 2.0 (1 hour), read 0.1: break-even at request 2 and 3
Semantic cache: threshold against hits and wrong answers
no cache costs 1.000; the best threshold depends on what a wrong answer costs:
wrong = 10 or 50: 0.95 at 1.020, which serves nothing from the cache
Sparse traffic breaks a prefix cache
at a 60-minute mean gap the 5-minute cache hits 8% of the time
and costs 1.16 per request: more than not caching
match the TTL to your inter-arrival time
different intents reached cosine 0.903 (opens vs closes)
the same intent can fall to 0.321
a threshold cannot separate close wording from the answer
